primary_object_card.object_statement: ConstraintBox is a deterministic, SMT-centered harness that constrains both user requests and untrusted LLM proposals, compiles owner-controlled MMM context, runs only named external capabilities through a broker, binds observations to finite obligations, and permits only a named next action within an explicit claim ceiling.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: The box constrains LLMs and users; LLMs do not decide its gates. Sim engines remain separate and supply real tests and failures.
Executable evidence, exact caller reachability, bounded claims, and deterministic gate obedience outrank narrative summaries.

primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: ConstraintBox sits around an untrusted language model and around the request given to that model. It makes the user state the goal, scope, assumptions, evidence standard, and allowed action; selects a source-attributed MMM context; gives the model room to propose and repair; runs only controller-selected external tool functions; and releases only the controller-rendered result that satisfies the fixed finite checks.

native_terms.ConstraintBox: The deterministic harness that owns effective policy, finite checks, retry budgets, evidence binding, settlement, and bounded release.
native_terms.MMM: A versioned and source-attributed context projection that changes salience and communication style but never decides a gate.
native_terms.capability ticket: A controller-issued one-use permission naming one external executable, function surface, fixture, resource bound, and expected artifact contract.
native_terms.audit explainer: A nonauthoritative LLM-facing view that may explain failures and propose repairs but cannot change policy, settlement, or release.

weirdness_signature: the user request is constrained before an LLM receives it
the LLM may hallucinate broadly while only well-formed bounded work can leave
personal memory and language patterns shape context without becoming gate authority
sim engines are operated by the box but remain outside the box
primary_object_card.domain: bounded user requests, untrusted model candidates, named external capability observations, and versioned finite policies
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: a parked, blocked, evaluation-error, or bounded-release record plus deterministic repair guidance
allowed_operations: validate and clarify user request fields
compile and hash an owner-controlled MMM context
ask an untrusted model for candidates and repairs
issue one-use capability tickets for registered external functions
bind broker observations to finite SMT obligations
settle a bounded disposition and render one permitted release
required_invariants: LLMs and councils never select effective policy or settlement
MMM content changes context but never directly changes a disposition
external engines run in separate processes and do not become ConstraintBox components
every released claim stays inside its named finite encoding and claim ceiling
missing evidence or solver uncertainty never becomes a pass
repair attempts cannot weaken obligations or reset controller-owned budgets
forbidden_substitutions: LLM judgement substituted for a deterministic gate
well-formed JSON substituted for observed execution
package import substituted for a named function operation
one passing fixture substituted for engine or scientific truth
audit prose substituted for release authority
proxy or analogy label substituted for the primary harness
general user stereotype substituted for source-attributed owner preferences
negative_controls: inject authority fields into the user request or model candidate
submit a copied receipt without a broker-observed call
poison or sever the registered operation
erase a load-bearing observation before SMT settlement
make the audit LLM demand a hold on every known-valid case
remove an explicit request assumption and require clarification
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: Adapters and probes must name what they preserve, what they lose, their preconditions, and a kill control. No adapter, sim result, MMM, audit, analogy, or proxy may replace the harness.
promotion_locks: no production-containment claim without exclusive mediated capabilities
no external-tool readiness claim from one function receipt
no CR or scientific promotion from a reused fixture
no user-profile inference promoted without owner attribution and versioning
primary_object_card.artifact_surface: versioned JSON requests, MMM manifests, capability receipts, solver comparisons, repair packets, and bounded release receipts

lateral_mappings.label: external sim estate
lateral_mappings.target: named function-level mathematical workloads and hostile controls
preconditions: one exact callable and fixture are controller registered
positive negative boundary poison and replay controls are fixed
lateral_mappings.kill_control: sever the named operation or replace the receipt with copied JSON; settlement must stop

lateral_mappings.label: personalized MMM
lateral_mappings.target: owner-specific language, salience, memory, and communication context
preconditions: every profile item is source-attributed and versioned
hard requirements and inferred preferences remain distinct
lateral_mappings.kill_control: change only the MMM while holding policy and evidence fixed; deterministic settlement must remain unchanged

lateral_mappings.label: external LLM audit explainer
preconditions: audit output is stored separately as untrusted advice
lateral_mappings.kill_control: force the auditor to recommend release or refusal; the deterministic disposition must remain unchanged

fixation_breakers: test a second independent encoding or engine before adopting a convenient proxy
retain a nearest valid passing twin beside every blocked case

loop_contract.repair_rule: repair the first failed deterministic clause without changing effective policy, the claim ceiling, or the remaining-attempt calculation
loop_contract.stop_condition: the bounded request is released, the retry budget is exhausted, or a named missing instrument or unresolved assumption requires owner input

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question asks for an answer; it is not authorization to implement unless the user explicitly says to do it.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Any sequence or ordering claim must be checked separately from content correctness, with the order witness named.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: When debugging runtime behavior, preserve the visible output baseline and debug the execution path underneath.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: A falsifier-first pass names the target, strongest falsifier, decisive check, and killed, open, or survived classification.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: A testability pass names the operation, the observable measured, and the pass/fail condition.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must name distinct receipts and explicitly refuse the merge, sequence, or reframe it is not performing.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve tool-recoverable work before asking; ask the human only for private, preference-bound, or unrecoverable information.

evidence_spine.wizard_runtime: Wizard v4.3 object-preservation guard only; v4.2 is legacy/provenance and is not a current run target.

source_math_locks.preserves: executable evidence, current authority, bounded worker receipts, and return to real sim work
gate obedience, status ceilings, and separation of narrative from executable evidence
source_math_locks.status: tracked process contract with explicit limits

evidence_spine.claim_ceiling: ConstraintBox object and boundary preservation only; no implementation, containment, sim-readiness, CR, or scientific claim
blocked_consumers: implementation-complete claim without caller and test evidence
external engine readiness or CR promotion
